answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ocean challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the crystal of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a plume of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1dq8h.
